description: Green Stitch Tailoring is a Sharjah-based tailoring studio focused on alterations, repairs, and custom fits using sustainable fabrics and low-waste production practices.

services.name: Alterations and repairs
services.description: Fast hemming, resizing, zip replacement, and garment repair for everyday wear and uniforms.

services.name: Custom tailoring
services.description: Made-to-measure tailoring for dresses, abayas, suits, and event wear with fabric guidance and fitting support.

services.name: Sustainable wardrobe refresh
services.description: Repurpose existing garments with fit improvements, repairs, and styling adjustments before replacing them.

faq.question: Do you offer same-day alterations in Sharjah?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected alterations and repairs can be completed on the same day depending on garment type and current workload.

faq.question: Can I book a fitting through WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Yes. Customers can request a fitting or alteration appointment through WhatsApp, phone, or the booking page.

faq.question: What makes Green Stitch Tailoring sustainable?
faq.answer: We prioritize repair before replacement, offer lower-waste alterations, and help customers extend the life of garments with fabric-conscious tailoring.
